Sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Harridax Kirill]] captured a '''vessel''' belonging to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that was carrying [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children. Kirill, better known as the Voidwolf, personally led the boarding party that killed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defenders aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and he took the children to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] as a "gift" to the Empire. The Empire rewarded the Voidwolf by promoting him from privateer to [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]].
